flags.message: The provisioned petition.txt for this pseudonymous (Jane Doe) pro se petitioner carries her personal contact email in the caption and signature block and detailed health and military-service history in the statement of the case. The record is a public filing, but the cell's prose outputs land in a public ledger, so I summarized rather than reproduced it and did not copy the contact details. Maintainers may want the document provisioner to scrub personal email addresses from pro se filings before they reach a cell.
